newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mandela to attend peace summit in Angola.
newsitem.headline: Mandela to attend peace summit in Angola.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela will travel to Luanda next week for a regional summit on Angola's fragile peace process, a government spokesman said on Friday.
Spokesman Pieter Swanepoel said Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe was scheduled to chair the meeting of leaders of the Southern African Development Community (SADC).
"They will be looking at the Angolan peace process," Swanepoel said.
He said the meeting was scheduled for Monday but official sources in Angola said it would be held on Wednesday. The discrepancy could not immediately be cleared.

The Angolan government and the UNITA opposition signed a peace accord in November 1994. Fighting in their 19-year civil war has all but stopped, although key aspects of the accord have yet to be implemented.
SADC groups Angola, Botswana, South Africa, Namibia, Swaziland, Lesotho, Mozambique, Mauritius, Malawi, Zimbabwe, Zambia and Tanzania.
